text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day is a special occasion
where you
give chocolate to those
important to you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And as one might expect, Tracen
Academy is
buzzing with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hello there, Trainer! Have you been
behaving
yourself recently? If so...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I have some chocolate for you. Thank
you very
much for all of your assistance
this year.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Well, you're not completely off
the mark,
but... isn't this what people do
on Valentine's
Day?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Many people do give out chocolate on

Valentine's, but Wonder Acute doesn't
seem to
be enjoying herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I could just accept the chocolate and let
it go,
but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh, she probably doesn't understand
the meaning
behind Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Don't get me wrong! I don't think Acute
dislikes
this sort of thing. Actually, I
think it's the
opposite...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she's too polite to insert herself
into things,
so if you don't ask her
yourself, she'll just stand
off to the side
looking sad.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So it might be better if you helped get
her into
the spirit! She's not one to get
excited about this
stuff on her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Speaking with Wonder Acute's friends
reassures
me that she has nothing
against Valentine's Day.
In which case...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can try to liven things up by giving her
a
present.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You wanted to speak with me, Trainer?
Oh, could
it be about the chocolate I
gave you earlier?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Would a set of fruit jellies have been
better? Or
maybe a rice coupon...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Goodness me. A Valentine's present for
me?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But it feels backwards receiving a gift
from
someone who's always helping me
out so much...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing wrong with a trainer
giving a
present to their trainee. As for
the contents...
choice_data_list: いや、これもアリだから
ううん、これもアリだから

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: W-wow!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A kudzu noodle set! Why, one would
have to visit
a high-class restaurant in a
department store for a
dessert this
luxurious.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: O-oooh...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Woo-hoo!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I'm very sorry about that. I just
never
imagined anyone would give me
something so
wonderful.
choice_data_list: 落ち着いて、アキュート！

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What's more, there are so many packets
in here...
One, two, three, four...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: WOO-HOO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Clearly, my gift went over without a
hitch. Hoping
to calm her down, I
suggest she try some, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, no, no. Eating it right away
would be such
a waste... I could never.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll have a little bit every day
after I finish
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Trainer... Don't you think I worked hard today? So...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Do you think I could have some of those
kudzu
noodles in the refrigerator?! Just
one pack!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, do you really mean it? Ahhh... I'm so
happy.
Thank you. Ehehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute is all smiles for the next
several
days. It seems my modest
Valentine's present
made her very happy
indeed.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Goodness me, what is this?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oooh... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute freezes, clutching the
bouquet of
flowers I gave her.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ho...
choice_data_list: ハッピーバレンタイン！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try breaking the silence, but Wonder
Acute
barely reacts. Thirty seconds tick
by until, all of a
sudden...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hah... Ahh... AHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Stop the presses! STOP THE PRESSES!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still holding the bouquet, Wonder
Acute zooms
out of my office.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Jordan! Jordan! Stop the presses!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's up with you? Is there, like, a
new nail
salon that just opened?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Nakayama! Nakayama! Stop the presses!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Judging by that bouquet... I guess some
legend
out there just made their final
play, eh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I frantically give chase all over the
academy
before finally catching up to
her on the roof.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I have to admit... I don't have
the
slightest idea what to do in this
situation.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's not it. I can't even begin to tell
you how
happy this beautiful bouquet
has made me...
choice_data_list: 食べられるものの方がよかった？
choice_data_list_en: Would you have preferred something edible?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My heart is so full of emotion that I
just... Ahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...She doesn't look displeased. In fact,
she seems
genuinely happy with the
unexpected gift.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute seems like she has
modest tastes,
so it's possible this is the
first time she's ever
received an
extravagant bouquet like this.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.... Really, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm deeply grateful that you've deigned
to bestow
such a lovely—words cannot
express the gratitude
for which I...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hm... It doesn't sound quite right. I'm
sure this is
the kind of thing you should
say when receiving a
gift, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: At any rate... Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute still seems unsure of how
to
express her feelings, but watching her
try fills my
heart with warmth.
